anchor.semantic_hook: The literal idea of going through no route becomes a dispatch junction where every physical route and communication conduit is visibly blocked.
anchor.setting: A formal dispatch hub has roads, telephone cables, pneumatic delivery tubes, and a parcel belt converging around a central desk. Every route ends at the same barrier before reaching its destination. The roads, cables, and tubes rise from the floor and tie themselves into one impossible knot in midair.

A single conveyor instantly ages each newly finished object into an ancient-looking museum relic before it enters a case.
